tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rjes 'jam dbyangs la zhus te red mda' bar gnang ba'i dris lan gyi 'grel pa bzhugs/

na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rten 'brel zab mo ji bzhin mngon gzigs nas/ /tshul bzhin gzhan la ston phyir mkhyen pa dang*/ /smra ba bla na med ces rab grags pa/ /ston pa mchog de'i zhabs pad spyi bos bsten/ /rgyal kun ye shes gcig bsdus 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /zab don 'grel mdzad klu sgrub 'phags pa lha/ /zhi ba lha dang grub mchog sangs rgyas bskyangs/ /zla ba'i zhabs sogs brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ /gang gi rnam dpyod gsal ba'i nyi 'od kyis/ /zab don mkha' la rmongs pa'i mun bcom nas/ /stong nyid 'dab stong rgyas mdzad smra ba'i nyi/ /rje btsun rgyal ba gnyis par grags la 'dud/ /mgon de'i bshad srol gdugs dkar thub bstan gyi/ /khang bzang rtse mor rnam dpyod dpung pa yis/ /btegs nas 'dzin mdzad rgyal tshab mkhas grub rje/ /paṇa chen rgyal dbang snga phyir byon rnam bsngags/ /gang dag yab rje bla ma'i legs bshad la/ /dad pa thob nas zab don mkhyen bzhed de/ /thugs bsam dag pa'i gsung gis bskul ba las/ /tshul 'di 'chad la cung zad spro bar gyur/ /de yang nyid kyi gsung shog tu rje rin po mes 'jam dbyangs la zhus nas red mda' bar gnang ba'i dri lan gyi rnam bshad rgyas pa don gsal ba zhig bgyis nas bskur zhig ces 'byung ba'i dri lan 'di/ rje'i gsung 'bum thor bu nas 'byung ba'i lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi skor la dogs gcod zhus pa dang*/ de'i mjug tu'ang nyams su len tshul zhig gnang 'dug pa 'di gnyis gang yin mi gsal yang gtso bo snga ma nyid yin pa gzhir bcas nas lan 'bul bar bya ste/ 'di nyid du nges 'byung sems bskyed lta ba'i nyams len la dogs gcod zhus pa gtso bor snang ba 'di la tshig 'grel dang*/ 'ga' zhig ni 'phros don nam zhar byung lta bu 'dug pa dang*/ go sla bas tshig 'grel rdzogs par mi dgos par mthong nas bsdus don gyi tshul du bshad par bya'o/

/gzhung 'di ni rjes rje btsun la dogs gcod mang po zhig zhus pa'i nang nas don bsdus nas yi ger bkod pa zhig ste/ rje btsun dang rje'i gsung gnyis 'dres mar snang la/ 'di'i 'go shog ni bla mthar bzang gi dpe nas gzhan du 'khyer nas mi 'dug ces mjug tu 'byung ba ltar ro/ /de'i 'phro la/ spyir stong pas yod mtha' dang snang bas med mtha' sel ba 'di rgyang pan gyi bar la thun mong ba yin pas zhes 'byung ba 'di la gnyis/ mtha' mdor bstan pa dang*/ so sor bshad pa'o/ /dang po la spyir mtha'i sgra ni/ rnam bshad rig pa las/ mtha' ni zad dang mjug chad dang*/ nye dang phyogs la smad pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ 'dus pa'i rgyud ṭika nas mtha'i sgra ko ṭi ni sgo dang rtse mo la'ang 'jug par bshad pa bzhin don mang po zhig la 'jug la/ mtha' bral gyi mtha' ni/ rtsa she'i ṭik+ka las 'byung ba ltar 'jug pa'i rnam bshad las kyang*/ des na 'di'i mtha' ni ltung ba'i gnas te/ 'jig rten na brag g.yang la mtha' dang*/ de las lhung ba la mtha' las lhung zhes smra ba ltar gang du bzung nas 'dzin pa po phung bar 'gyur ba la mthar lhung zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa la/ de ltar mtha' zhes pa'i ming 'dra yang don mi 'dra ba mang bas gzhan sde dang rang sde grub mtha' bzhi kas mtha' 'dod tshul la mi 'dra ba 'byung ste/ 'di ltar gzhan sdes rang sde'i thun mong ma yin pa'i 'dod tshul rnams 'gog cing*/ rang sdes kyang gzhan sde'i thun mong ma yin pa'i 'dod pa rnams 'gog pa'i phyir te/ gzhan sdes rang sde rnams kyis gang zag gi bdag med khas len pa de 'gog /bye brag smra bas gzhan sdes 'dod pa'i rtag pa'i bdag 'gog /bye smras rtag rdzas 'dod pa de mdo sde pas 'gog /des rags pa'i phyi don 'dod pa de sems tsam pas 'gog /des shes pa bden grub 'dod pa de dbu ma pas 'gog rang rgyud pa man chad rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa 'dod pa de thal 'gyur bas 'gog pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir/

de ltar na snang stong gnyis kyi 'dod tshul dang mtha' sel ba'i 'dod tshul yang mi 'dra'o/ /'on kyang thun mong du grags pa tsam mtshon na/ rtsod gzhi gang yin pa zhig gzhir bzung nas snang ba yod pa dang*/ tshad mas grub pa dang*/ rtag mi rtag dang*/ mthong thos sogs kyi rtags las/ de'i zlog zla med pa dang*/ ma grub pa la sogs pa'i med pa'i phyogs sam mtha' sel zhing*/ de bzhin du stong pa med pa dang*/ ma grub pa la sogs pa'i rtags kyis bzlog zla yod pa dang*/ tshad mas grub pa la sogs pa yod pa'i phyogs sam mtha' sel lo/ /rgyang pan pas ni kho rang gi gzhung las/ ci tsam dbang po'i spyod yul ba/ /skyes bu de tsam kho na zad/ /ces 'byung ba ltar tshe 'di'i phung po tsam las gzhan 'jig rten pha rol med par 'dod pas kho rang ltar na shi nas 'jig rten pha rol tu 'gro ba dbang po'i mngon sum gyis ma mthong ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ 'jig rten pha rol med ces 'dod cing de kho rang gi lugs kyi stong pas yod mtha' sel tshul yin yang*/ spyir stong pas yod mtha' sel tshul du mi rung ste/ 'jig rten pha rol rgyang pan pa'i mngon sum gyis ma mthong yang yod pa'i phyir te/ rgyang pan pa ni rgyu ྄'bras kyi shes bya la blo phyin ci log tu song nas 'jig rten pha rol med par khas blangs pa'i phyir te/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ 'jig rten pha rol 'gog par byed pa'i dus su bdag nyid ni/ /shes bya'i rang bzhin phyin ci log tu blta bar rtogs bya ste/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'khor 'das kyi mtha' gnyis lta bu yod kyang*/ rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis med de/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis med cing tha snyad du yod pas rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i phyir/ mthar lhung ba yod pa dang mi 'gal te/ de ni blos mtha' gnyis su 'dzin tshul gyi dbang du mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /bden 'dzin gyi zhen yul la rtag mtha' zhes pa ni brtag pa mtha' bzung tsam zhig ste/

de'i zhen yul la bden grub bam bdag dang rang bzhin zhes zer yang bden grub yin pa med pa bzhin no/ /de ltar yang lam rim chen mo las/ des ji ltar bzung ba'i zhen yul chos rnams kyi rang rang gi sdod lugs de la ni bdag gam rang bzhin zhes brtag pa mtha' bzung gi sgo nas ngos bzung bar bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na/ yod ces bya ba rtag par lta/ med ces bya ba chad par ltar/ zhes 'byung ba ni dngos po rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dzin pa ni rtag pa'i mthar 'dzin pa dang*/ las 'bras sogs med par 'dzin pa ni 'chad pa'i mthar 'dzin du 'gyur ba'i don yin gyi spyir yod med du 'dzin pa tsam min no/ /7 de nas/ thal 'gyur pa'i khyad chos la snang bas yod mtha' dang stong pas med mtha' sel zhing*/ zhes sogs kyi don la yang spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ skabs 'di dang lam gyi gtso bo rnams gsum las/ gzhan yang snang bas yod mtha' sel ba dang*/ /stong pas med mtha' sel zhing stong pa nyid/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur 'gyur ba'i tshul shes na/ /mthar 'dzin lta bas 'phrog par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa gnyis don 'dra bar snang ste/ tshul 'di la mkhas pa kha cig 'di skad ces gsungs te/ 'di dag ni thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyi dbang du mdzad pa yin gyi/ spyir grub mtha' smra ba bzhi kas stong pas yod mtha' dang med mtha' gnyis ka sel zhing*/ snang bas kyang yod med kyi mtha' de gnyis ka sel ba'i tshul yang yod de/ 'di ltar grub mtha' bzhi so so nas rang rang gis ngos bzung ba'i dgag bya de dang des stong pa la bya byed 'thad par 'dod cing*/ bya byed 'thad pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis dgag bya de dang stong pa la nges pa 'dren thub par bzhed pa'i phyir te/ don smra sde gnyis kyi phung po las don gzhan pa'i bdag gis stong pa'i bdag med la bdag dang las 'bras sogs kyi bya byed 'thad par bzhed/ sems tsam pas gzung ba phyi rol don gyis stong pa la bya byed 'thad par bzhed la de dang rang rgyud pa gnyis kas rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod kyis stong pa dang*/

chos kyi bdag med la'ang rgyu 'bras kyi bya byed 'thad par bzhed cing*/ snang stong re res kyang mtha' gnyis sel nus par bzhed pa'i phyir te/ don smra sde gnyis kyis gang zag gi bdag gis stong pa la gang zag sogs kyi bya byed 'thad par bzhed pa stong pas med mtha' sel/ gang zag gi bdag tu grub pa med kyang phung po'i tshogs rgyun la bdag 'jog pa'i tshul la nges pa rnyed pas snang bas yod mtha' sel/ sems tsam pas gzugs sogs phyi rol don gyis stong pa la bya byed 'thad pas stong pas med mtha' dang*/ phyi rol don du snang ba tsam ma gtogs gzung 'dzin rgyangs chad du snang ba ltar stong pas snang bas yod mtha' sel/ dbu ma pa gnyis kas kyang bden pas stong pa la gzugs sogs dang bya byed 'thad pas stong pas med mtha' dang*/ rten 'brel yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bden grub khegs pas snang bas yod mtha' sel nus shing*/ de las bzlog ste yang sel nus pa'i phyir zhes 'dod de re zhig de ltar ro/ /thal 'gyur ba ltar na rang rgyud pa man chad mtha' gnyis su lhung bar 'dod kyang*/ de dag rang rang so so nas mtha' gnyis su lhung bar mi 'dod de/ rang rang so so nas rang la mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i lta ba re yod par 'dod pa'i phyir te/ de thams cad kyis kyang lta ba bka' brtags kyi phyag rgya bzhi khas len pa'i phyir ro/ /thal 'gyur thun mong min pa'i snang bas chad mtha' dang*/ stong pas yod mtha' 'gog tshul ni/ rje'i gsung 'bum las/ rten 'byung mi bslu ba'i nges pa brnyed pas chad mtha' 'gog cing*/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i dmigs gtad rdul tsam yang ma grub pa'i rang bzhin med pa'i stong nyid la nges pa brnyed pas rtag mtha' las grol zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa la/ 'o na sngar bshad pa ltar grub mtha' bzhi ka la snang bas yod mtha' dang stong pas med mtha' 'gog tshul yod na/ de 'dir thal 'gyur ba'i khyad chos su bshad pa ji ltar yin zhe na/

mkhas pa kha cig sgras zin ltar bzhed kyang*/ snga ma'i lugs de re zhig khas blangs nas 'di ltar bya ste/ chos rnams rang bzhin gyis stong bar bzhed pa'i thal 'gyur ba'i lugs 'dir snang bas yod mtha' dang stong pas med mtha' sel tshul khyad par can zhig yod pa de/ rang rgyud pa man chad kyi lugs la mi 'byung bas lugs 'di'i khyad chos su 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar zhe na/ rten 'brel gyi rtags kyis rang bzhin med par sgrub pa'i sbyor ba gcig la brten pa'i mtha' gnyis sel tshul ni/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum las/ 'dir ni thal 'gyur ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos snang bas yod mtha' dang stong pas med mtha' sel ba'i don cung zad brjod na/ myu gu chos can/ rang bzhin gyis med de/ rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir zhes rtags su bkod pa'i tshe na/ myu gu chos can med de zhes ma brjod par rang bzhin gyis med de zhes dgag bya'i khyad par sbyar bas ni/ myu gu rang bzhin gyis med pa yin gyi/ gtan med pa min par rtogs nus pas stong pas med mtha' sel ba'i don yin la/ rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i rtags kyis myu gu rang gi rgyu rkyen la brten nas sam ltos nas grub par go nus pas/ rang bzhin gyis grub na rgyu rkyen la ltos mi dgos pa'i don gyis rang bzhin gyis med par shes la/ de ni snang bas yod mtha' sel ba'i don no/ /de'i phyir rten 'brel gyi rtags kyi byed pas rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis dus gcig tu 'gog nus pas rigs pa'i rgyal po rten 'brel zhes kyang gsungs so/ /zhes dang*/ rje de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma stong nyid bdun cu pa'i 'grel par yang*/ de yang myu gu chos can/ rang bzhin gyis med de/ rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir zhes rtags su bkod pa'i tshe/ bsgrub bya blo yul du song bas rang bzhin gyis yod par 'dzin pa'i rtag mtha' sel/

rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i gtan tshigs blo yul du song bas myu gu ming tsam gyi rten 'brel du rtogs pas/ de gtan med pa'i chad mtha' sel pas rtag dpyad gnyis dus gcig tu sel ba dang*/ yang myu gu ltos grub pa'i ming tsam gyi rten 'brel du nges pas nges shes kyis de rang bzhin med pa la nges shes 'dren pas snang bas yod mtha' sel zhing*/ myu gu rang bzhin gyis med par nges pa nyid kyi tha snyad du rang gi sa bon las skye ba dang*/ rgyu med dang mi mthun pa'i rgyu las mi skye ba sogs kyi tha snyad kyi rnam gzhag thams cad 'thad pa'i snang phyogs la nges shes 'dren pas stong pas med mtha' sel bas rigs pa'i rgyal po zhes bya'o/ /zhes tshul gnyis gsungs pa dang*/ yang des mdzad pa'i rten 'brel bstod pa'i ṭik+ka las/ de yang spyir stong pas yod mtha' dang snang bas med mtha' sel ba tsam rgyang 'phen gyi bar gyi grub mtha' gong 'og thams cad thun mong ba yin pas/ thal 'gyur ba'i lugs la de las ldog ste snang bas yod mtha' dang stong pas med mtha' sel zhing*/ zhes pa nas/ rten 'brel yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rang bzhin gyis stong pa la nges shes 'dren dgos pa de bzhin du/ rang bzhin gyis stong ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis rten 'brel la nges shes 'dren pa cig dgos te/ zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bsdu zhing go bde ba la ni de tsam gyis mchog mod/ rgyas pa zhig ces gsungs pas go don dang sbyar nas cung zad sgros te bshad na/ mtha' de ltar sel tshul ston pa'i gzhung ni/ rtsa she las/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gang*/ /de ni stong pa nyid du bshad/ /ces sogs dang*/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ de la thams cad rung ba 'gyur/ zhes sogs dang*/ rten 'brel bstod par/ gang gang rkyen la rag las pa/ /de de rang bzhin gyis stong zhes/ zhes dang*/ de phyir brten nas 'byung ba la/

/ma gtogs chos 'gal yod yin pas/ /rang bzhin gyis ni stong pa la/ /ma gtogs chos 'ga' med par gsungs/ /zhes pa lta bu sogs mang la/ mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtshos mtha' gnyis sel tshul la gnyis bshad de/ thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba'i go ba mthar son pa'i skabs dang*/ myong ba rnam dag skyes pa'i skabs so/ /dang po ni/ de'i gsungs las chos thams cad rang gi rgyu'am gdags gzhi la rnam pa lngas bcal na mi dmigs pas yul steng nas ngo bos grub pa cung zad tsam yang med par rang gi rgyu rkyen nam gdags gzhi la brten nas btags pa'i btags chos phar bzhag pa tsam de thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i don yin pas/ de lta bu'i rten 'byung gi don legs par go ba'i gang zag gis myu gu sogs kyi chos gang dang gang de lta bu'i rten 'byung du nam blo la shar ba'i tshe chos de dang de rang bzhin gyis stong pa la nges pa 'dren cing*/ gcig tu bral lta bu'i rigs pas dpyad de chos gang dang gang rang bzhin med par rtogs pa de'i tshe/ chos de dang de tha snyad du yod tshul rtog pas btags pa tsam gyi rten 'byung du 'bad med 'char ba rnams ni/ snang bas yod mtha' sel ba dang stong pas med mtha' sel ba'i tshul gcig go /zhes dang*/ gnyis pa nyams myong rnam dag skyes pa'i gnas skabs kyi snang bas yod mtha' sel tshul sogs ni/ mnyam gzhag stong nyid la myong ba thon pa'i rnal 'byor pa des mnyam gzhag las langs pa'i dus su ri rab khang khyim la sogs pa snang ba'i tshe/ ri la sogs pa de dang de rang bzhin gyis med pa lhang lhang 'char ba ni snang bas yod mtha' sel tshul dang*/ rang bzhin gyis stong bar shar ba de nyid kyis gang snang thams cad rtog pas btags pa tsam du 'char ba ni stong pas ming mtha' sel ba'i tshul yin la/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa rnams ni/ chos rnams rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba nyid yin pas bden pas stong bar bzhed kyang rten 'byung gi don la khyad shin tu che bas/

gong du bshad ma thag pa'i snang bas yod mtha' sel ba sogs thal 'gyur ba'i khyad chos yin te/ zhes gsungs pa ltar te gnad shin tu che'o/ /rgyal dbang lnga bas kyang lam gtso'i tshig 'grel las/ gzhan yang blo ldan gang gis mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i dbu ma'i lta ba la nges pa 'dren tshul ni/ snang ba rten 'brel mi bslu ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i rtag pa'i mtha' sel ba ste 'gog pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyis stong pas tha snyad du med pa'i chad mtha' sel ba ste 'gog nus shing*/ zhes gsungs te snga ma de dag dang don 'dra'o/ ༈ /stong nyid rgyu 'bras su 'gro tshul shes dgos la/ 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams rgyu la brten nas 'bras bu 'byung zhing mi bslu ba'i tshul rang lugs su khas len la/ de nyid kyis mtha' thams cad spong ba'i stong pa nyid du 'gyur tshul sogs dpag tu med pa yod la/ zhes gsungs pa'i don phal cher snga ma de dag tu 'dus shing*/ stong nyid rgyu 'bras su 'gyur ba ni/ lam gtsor stong pa nyid/ rgyu dang 'bras bur 'gyur ba'i tshul shes na/ zhes gsungs pa dang don gcig cing*/ de yang rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung ba ni shin tu 'thad pa'i don yin te/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis sems 'grel las/ chos rnams stong pa 'di shes nas/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu brten pa gang*/ /ngo mtshar bas kyang 'di ngo mtshar/ /rmad byung bas kyang 'di rmad byung*/ /zhes dang*/ /rjes rten 'brel bstod par/ /'di kun ngo bos stong pa dang*/ /'di las 'di 'bras 'byung ba yi/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan cing*/ dpal ldan zla bas kyang*/ dngos po stong pa gzugs brnyan la sogs pa/ /tshogs la bltos rnams ma grags par yang min/ /ji ltar de yi gzugs brnyan sogs stong las/ /shes pa de yi rnam pa skye 'gyur ltar/ /de bzhin dngos po thams cad stong na yang*/ /stong nyid dag las rab tu skye bar 'gyur/

/zhes gsungs shing*/ de'i 'grel par rjes/ dngos po stong ba ste gzugs brnyan dang la sogs pa/ zhes pa nas/ brdzun pa'i gzugs brnyan las brdzun pa'i rnam pa can gyi shes pa skye ba de bzhin du dngos po thams cad rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pas stong na yang*/ des stong pa'i rgyu dag las des stong pa'i 'bras bu dag rab tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gzugs brnyan bya byad bzhin du snang yang der ma grub pa ltar rgyu 'bras kyi dngos po rang bzhin gyis grub par snang yang der ma grub pa gnyis 'dra ba ni/ rnam bshad de nyid las/ byad bzhin du stong pa'i gzugs brnyan lta bu de la snang ba'i cha 'di tsam zhig byed bzhin du snang la/ 'di tsam zhig byad bzhin du mi snang ngo zhes rnam pa thams cad du dbyer mi nus la/ byad bzhin du gang snang gi cha thams cad nas snang ba ltar du yod pas stong yang*/ rang gi rgyu la brten nas 'bras bu skye ba mi 'gal ba dper byas nas/ dpe de bzhin du sngon po rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa snang ba na yang sngon po'i steng nas rang bzhin gyis grub par snang mi snang gi cha gnyis dbyer med par snang la/ de ltar snang ba yang gang snang gi cha thams cad nas snang ba ltar du stong yang*/ rang gi rgyus rang gi 'bras bu bskyed pa mi 'gal par sgrub pa yin te/ des na rang gi ngo bos med pas yod mtha' thams cad dang*/ de nyid la rang bzhin med pa'i rgyu 'bras 'jog nus pas med mtha' thams cad las grol ba slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs dang slob dpon zla ba'i zhabs kyis 'phags pa'i dgongs pa bkral ba'i khyad chos su snang zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /byad bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan byad bzhin du gang snang gi cha nas byad bzhin gyis stong pa ltar/ so skye'i shes pa la rgyu 'bras sogs gang snang thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub par snang zhing*/ gang snang gi cha thams cad nas rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong par gsungs pa ni dgag bya phra mo nas 'gog tshul yin te/

rang rgyud pas so skye'i dbang shes la gzugs sogs yul lnga rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par snang zhing snang ba ltar yul lnga'i rang mtshan la tshad mar song bas/ gzugs brnyan lta bu ma yin pa'i gzugs sgra sogs snang ba snang ba ltar grub pa'i kun rdzob tu bzhed/ thal 'gyur las so skye'i dbang po'i mngon sum rnams kyang yul lnga'i rang mtshan la 'khrul pas de la tshad mar ma song zhing snang ba de snang ba ltar ma grub par bzhed pa'i phyir te/ de ltar lam rim las bshad cing gzhan yang lam rim chen mor/ de la rang bzhin med pa'i lta ba ma rnyed gong du gang zag de dag gi yod pa tsam dang rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa'i yod pa gnyis so sor phyed pa mi srid de/ zhes gsungs pas kyang shes pa'i phyir ro/ /des na paṇa chen gong mas phyag chen 'grel bar/ rang cag so skye'i blo la ji ltar snang ba 'di rtags kyi dgag byar bshad cing*/ mkhas pa gzhan 'ga' zhig kyang de ltar 'dod pa ni 'thad par mthong ngo*/ /'on kyang snang ba tsam rtags kyi dgag bya min gyi/ snang ba ltar grub pa ni rtags yang dag gi dgag byar 'dod do/ /gzhan yang stong nyid rgyu 'bras su 'gro tshul legs par shes pa ni stong pa brten 'byung gi don du 'gro tshul go ba la rag las shing*/ de yang gong du bshad pa de dag yin med/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa brten 'byung gi don du ston pa'i gzhung gzhan ni/ ma dros pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes/ de la skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin/ rkyen la rag las gang de stong par bshad/ gang zhig stong nyid shes de bag yod yin/ zhes dang*/ de'i don rjes/ gang gang rkyen la rag las pa/ /de de rang bzhin gyis stong zhes/ /zhes pas 'chad cing*/ mgon pos rtsa she las/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung bar gang*/ /de ni ngo bo nyid kyis zhi/ /zhes dang*/ rtsod zlog las/ gang zhig stong dang rten 'byung dang*/

dbu ma'i lam du don gcig par/ zhes dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa las kyang*/ rten cing 'brel bar gang 'byung ba/ /de nyid khyod kyis stong par bzhed/ /zhes dang*/ bzhi brgya pa las/ ga nga la brten nas 'byung yod pa/ /de ni rang dbang mi 'gyur re/ /zhes dang*/ de'i 'grel par/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba rang dbang ba'i ngo bo dang bral ba'i phyir rang dbang pa'i ngo bo dang bral ba'i don stong pa nyid kyi don yin gyi/ zhes dang*/ lam rin chen mor/ shes ldan dag rang bzhin stong pa nyid ky-i don ni rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i don yin gyi/ zhes dang*/ tshig gsal las kyang de ltar bshad do/ /rje nor bzang rgya mtshos kyang*/ chos rnams rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i don ni/ chos rnams yul steng nas rdul tsam yang med par ming ngam rtog pas phar btags nas bzhag pa tsam yin pa'i don gnyis gcig pa 'di/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gang*/ /de ni stong pa nyid du bshad/ /ces rten 'byung dang stong pa don gcig tu bshad pa'i don yin no/ /rgyu mtshan des na myu gu brten nas btags pa tsam gyi btags yod ming rkyang du rtogs pa'i gang zag des myu gu rang bzhin gyi ma grub pa ci'i phyir mi rtogs/ de yang gang zag de'i rgyud kyi myu gu rang bzhin gyis ma grub snyam du 'dzin pa'i blo de la myu gu btags pa tsam du 'dzin pa'i 'dzin stangs med cing*/ btags pa tsam du 'dzin pa'i blo de la rang bzhin gyis ma grub par 'dzin pa'i 'dzin stangs med kyang*/ gang zag des myu gu btags yod mi rkyang du rtogs pa nyid kyis myu gu rang bzhin gyis med par rtogs pa yin te/ zhes sogs dpe dang bcas nas gsungs te gnad che'o/ /yang rjes rtsa she'i ṭika chen las/ /gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes/ /zhes sogs kyi rkyen la rag las pa'i don gang yin pa de nyid rang la tshugs thub kyi rang bzhin med pa stong pa'i don du bshad pa'i phyir rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i sgra'i don gang yin pa de nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i don yin gyi/

zhes dang gal te rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa'-i don ni rten 'byung gi don yin no zhes mang du gsungs na/ 'di'i don gang yin zhes dri ba bkod nas lan du/ stong pa rten 'byung gi don du 'gro ba ni rang bzhin gyis grub pa tshad mas khegs pas dbu ma pa rnams la yin gyi gzhan la min no/ /de 'dra ba'i dbu ma pa la ni phyi nang gi dngos po rnams rgyu la rag las pa'i rten 'byung du dngos su nges pa na/ blo de nyid kyi mthu la brten nas rang bzhin gyis yod pas stong ba'i don du nges par 'gyur te/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa gzhan la ltos pa med par tshad mas rtogs shing de dang rten 'byung gnyis 'gal bar tshad mas rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na/ rten 'byung nyid kyis rang bzhin gyis yod pa khegs pa'i stong nyid la nges pa rnyed pa ni nam myu gu la sogs pa rgyu rkyen la ltos par mthong ba dang thos pa dang*/ dran pa'i mod la/ rgyu mtshan de nyid kyis rang bzhin med pa yin pa'i tshul bsam pa la goms par bya'o/ /zhes dang*/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtshos stong nyid bdun cu'i 'grel bar yang*/ rten 'brel gyi don rang bzhin stong pa nyid du rtogs pa na/ las 'bras dang 'khor 'das sogs ming rkyang btags yod tsam gyi snang phyogs rten 'brel gyi nges pa la mi gnod pa'i steng du phan 'dogs pa zhig dang*/ chos rnams rang rang gi gdags gzhi la rtog pas phar bzhag tsam rkyang ba ma gtogs/ yul steng nas grub pa'i ngo bo nyid rdul tsam yang med pa'i nges pa rnyed pa na/ rgyu 'bras sogs rten 'brel gyi snang ba blo la shar tsam nas de dag rang bzhin med par cham gyis nges nus pa zhig 'byung ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rang bzhin gyis med cing rtog pas btags tsam gyi chos la bya byed kyi rnam gzhag thams cad 'thad par gting nas 'jog shes pa'i dbu ma'i lta ba 'di rnyed dka' ba yin te/

lam rim chen mo las/ des na rigs pas rnam par dpyad pa na gang zag la sogs pa rang gi ngo bos grub pa'i yul steng du sdod tshul cung zad kyang mi 'dug go snyam pa dang*/ de la brten nas snang ba 'di rnams ban bun du 'char ba tsam dka' ba min gyi/ de 'dra ba de dbu ma'i grub mtha' la mos shing rang bzhin med pa'i tshul ston pa'i chos than thun thos pa thams cad la 'ong yang*/ dka' sa ni rang gi ngo bos grub pa'i rang bzhin ma lus par khegs pa dang*/ rang bzhin med pa'i gang zag la sogs pa de nyid las gsog pa po dang 'bras bu myong ba po la sogs pa 'jog pa la nges pa gting nas 'drongs te/ de rnams su 'jog thub pa'i nyis tshogs de srid mtha' tsam du song bas dbu ma'i lta ba brnyed pa dka' ba yin no/ /zhes dang*/ gsung 'bum thor bu las kyang de ltar 'byung zhing*/ dgongs pa rab gsal las/ rtog pas bzhag pa de la rang rang gi bya byed 'thad pa ni/ zhes pa nas/ dbu ma'i lta ba mthar thug pa'i dka' sa yang de nyid do/ /zhes dang*/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rten 'brel stod ba'i ṭik+kar yang*/ des na thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyi chos dang gang zag gi steng du'ang rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa bcad tsam gyi med dgag nyid shes dka' ba min gyi/ rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa rdul tsam yang med pa dang tha snyad du rgyu 'bras 'khor 'das sogs gzhan ngo tsam ma yin par rang lugs la 'jog shes shing*/ bsnyon med du khas blangs chog pa cig mi shes kha ming dang de 'dra'i gnyis tshogs de 'jog pa shin tu dka' ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /chos rnams rtog pas bzhag tshul dang btags yod tsam du 'jog tshul gzhung che ba nas bshad pa rnams drangs na mang du dogs pas mtshon tsam zhig brjod na/ sa rdo shing sogs las tho yor byas pa'i tshe/ sa rdo sogs la dang po nas tho yor med kyang de dag tshogs pa la glo bur du ming dang rtog pas tho yor zhes brda byas pa tsam gyis tho yor du 'gyur ba bzhin te/

dpyad pa'i tshe sa rdo sogs re re'am tshogs pa dang dbyibs dang kha dog gang yang tho yor min zhing*/ de las ngo bo tha dad pa'i tho yor zhig kyang med de rtog pas btags pa tsam mo/ /de bzhin du gzhan du sbyar bar bya ste/ sa rdo sogs las grub pa'i ri rab sogs dang*/ khang ba sogs dang*/ tshon sna tshogs las grub pa'i sku 'dra'am gang zag gzhan gyi gzugs brnyan dang*/ 'jim pa dang gser dngul sogs las sku brnyan dang ka bum sogs dang*/ snam bu sogs las grub pa'i zhwa gos sogs dang*/ phreng ba dang*/ nags tshal dang*/ dmag dang*/ dge 'dun tshogs pa sogs dang*/ cha shas sam rgyu rkyen tshogs pa kun la'ang sbyor/ gang zag rnams kyang de ltar yin te/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ skyes bu sa min chu ma yin/ /zhes sogs dang*/ spyod 'jug las kyang*/ so dang skra sen bdag ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ skyes bu gang zag rnams ni/ rang gi gdags gzhi phung khams skye mched sogs la btags pa tsam yin gyi/ gdags gzhi phung khams sogs kyi ya gyal dang tshogs pa dang dbyibs sogs gang yang skyes bu min la/ de dag las don gzhan na yan gar ba'i skyes bu med de rtog pas btags pa tsam mo/ /spyir mtshan nyid pa la grags pa'i spyi zhes pa rnams ming rkyang btags yod tsam du 'jog pa ni sla ste/ shes bya/ dngos po/ bum pa sogs kyang spyi tsam nas brjod pa yin la/ der ma zad khang pa gcig gi nang du ka ba ci tsam yod kyang de thams cad la rjes su 'gro ba'i ka ba spyi tsam zhig kyang yod cing*/ mi bye brag pa du yod kyang bye brag pa de rnams la rjes su 'gro ba'i mi zhes spyi tsam zhes kyang yod de btags pa tsam mo/ /las kyis byas pa'i lha mi sogs dang*/ rtsol bas byas pa'i ka bum sogs lta bu sems yod med kyi khyad par tsam ma gtogs gdags gzhi tshogs pa la brten nas btags pa 'dra ste/ lha mi sogs gang zag thams cad gzugs sems gnyis sam phung po lnga tshogs pa la brten nas btags/

ka bum sogs 'byung ba dang 'byung 'gyur gyi gzugs tsam tshogs pa la brten nas btags te/ mdor na/ mi lta bu phung po'i cha shas tshogs pa la brten nas btags la/ gzugs lta bu yan lag gam cha shas tshogs pa la btags pa de bzhin du cha shas rnams kyang rang rang gi cha shas la bltos nas cha can yin pas de la brten nas btags pa'i tshul/ rigs pas ded nas chos gzhan thams cad la sbyar nas rang bzhin med par shes par bya ste/ sdud pa las/ bdag ci 'dra ba de 'drar sems can thams cad shes/ sems can thams cad ci 'dra de 'drar chos kun shes/ zhes dang*/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal por/ ji ltar khyod kyis bdag gis 'du shes ni/ shes pa de bzhin kun la blos sbyar bya/ zhes dang*/ 'phags pa lhas/ gcig gi lta bo gang yin pa/ de ni kun gyi lta bo yin/ gcig gi stong nyid gang yin pa/ de ni kun gyi stong nyid yin/ zhes dang*/ dngos gcig dngos po kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /dngos kun dngos po gcig gi ngo bo nyid/ /gang gi dngos gcig de bzhin nyid mthong ba/ de yi dngos kun de bzhin nyid du mthong*/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ /'khor 'das kyi chos rnams kyi rgyu 'bras mi bslu bar gsungs pa'i don la gnyis te/ phyi'i rgyu 'bras dang*/ nang gi rgyu 'bras mi slu ba'i tshul lo/ dang po ni/ gro nas sogs sa bon sna tshogs dang*/ rtsa shing sogs las kyang rang rang gi rigs kyi 'bras bu gang yin rnams ma nor bar 'byung zhing nor nas 'byung mi srid pa'i mi slu ba dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ mi dge ba las sdug bsngal kun/ /de bzhin ngan 'gro thams cad do/ /dge las bde 'gro thams cad dang*/ /skye ba kun tu bde ba dang*/ /ces dang*/ mdzod las/ 'jig rten sna tshogs las las skyes/ /zhes dang*/ 'jug pa las kyang*/ 'gro ba ma lus las las skyes par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nang gi rgyu dge mi dge byas pa las 'bras bu bde 'gro ngan 'gro gnyis dang de'i bde sdug ma nor bar 'byung ba'i tshul spyi dang*/

khyad par du sdud pa las/ sems can tha ma 'bring dang mchog gyur ji snyed pa/ /de kun ma rig las byung bde bar gshegs pas gsungs/ zhes 'byung ba ltar/ ma rig pa'i 'khor ba 'grub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo byed pa dang*/ ye shes tshul sgo thabs dang rtsa ba ji snyed pa/ de kun shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog las byung*/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis thar ba 'grub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo byed cing*/ mdor na kun byang ngam 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams kyi rgyu 'bras mi slu ba la nges pa rnyed par bya'o/ /de yang rtsa she las/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ rjes kyang*/ rang bzhin gyis ni stong pa dang*/ /bya byed 'thad pa mi 'gal zhing*/ /zhes sogs dang*/ rang bzhin 'ga' yang med pa dang*/ /'di la brten nas 'di 'byung ba'i/ /zhes sogs dang*/ gong du bshad pa ltar stong pa rten 'brel gyi don du shes na khyad che ba yin te/ lam rim chen mo las/ stong nyid kyi don go na ni de nyid rten 'brel gyi don du mthong nas las 'bras la nges pa skye ba'i grogs su 'gyur te/ mdo de nyid las/ /skyu ma chu bur rmi lam glog 'dra zhing*/ /chos rnams thams cad chu yi zla ba 'dra/ /shi nas 'jig rten pha rol 'gro ba yi/ /sems can shed las skyes pa mi dmigs kyang*/ /las rnams byas pa med par mi 'gyur te/ /dkar nag ji bzhin 'bras bu smin par byed/ /rigs pa'i tshul gyis sgo 'di bzang po ste/ /phra zhing mthong dka' rgyal ba'i spyod yul yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar rgyu 'bras mi slu ba'i tshul rang lugs su khas len pa yin la/ de nyid kyis mtha' thams cad spong ba'i stong nyid du 'gyur tshul la sogs dpag tu med pa yod ces pa'i don gong du brjod pa ltar ro/ ༈ /rgyu 'bras de yang sngon gyi dbu ma pa kha cig gzhan ngor mi slu zhing*/

rang lugs la slu mi slu'i rnam gzhag gang yang khas mi len zer ba ltar yang min gyi rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag rang lugs su khas len pa yin la/ rten 'brel stong pa dbyer med du sbyor ba'i tshe/ lam gtso las/ snang ba rten 'brel slu ba med pa dang*/ /stong pa khas len bral ba'i go ba gnyis/ /ji srid so sor snang ba de srid du/ /da dung thub pa'i dgongs pa rtogs pa med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar snang stong gnyis blo ngor gcig tu 'du mi nus pa'i res 'jog min zhing*/ don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs pas ma dpyad na rgyu 'bras mi slu bar mthong zhing dpyad nas rgyu 'bras 'di yin ma rnyed pa'i rjes nas bsam/ phyis da gzod rgyu 'bras mthong tsam nas/ dpyad nas ma rnyed pa dang ma dpyad na rnyed pa de gnyis gzhi gcig gi steng du 'gal med du sbyor nus pa la bsams nas rten 'brel dang stong pa dbyer med du byed pa tsam yang min gyi/ ji ltar zhe na/ de ni lam gtso las/ nam zhig res 'jog med par cig char du/ /rten 'brel mi slur mthong ba tsam nyid nas/ /nges shes yul gyi 'dzin stangs kun 'jig na/ /de tshe lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs pa lags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ltar snang stong zung 'jug tu shes dgos so/ /shes tshul la ji ltar yin zhe na/ de ni blo so so ma yin par rgyu la brten nas 'bras bu 'byung bar mi slu bar mthong ba'i blo de nyid kyis/ blo gzhan la ltos med du rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dzin pa'i rtog pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi dmigs pa'i gtad so zhig pa'i stong pa yang shes yong ba'i tshul dang*/ rgyu 'bras mi slu ba'i gtan tshigs sam rgyu mtshan de nyid kyis rtags gzhan la ltos med du yod med kyi mtha' sogs dang bral ba'i stong pa grub pa'i tshul shes pa las/ btags yod ming rkyang tsam la rgyu 'bras mi slu ba'i 'jog tshul la sngar ltar gting nas nges shes 'drongs pa 'ong zhing*/

de ltar shes pa'i tshul de ka nas bden 'dzin gyis bzung ba ltar med pa'i dmigs gtad zhig pa'i zhen med kyang 'ong ba yin no/ /de ni lam gtsor/ gang zhig 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /rgyu 'bras nam yang slu ba med mthong zhing*/ /dmigs pa'i gtad so gang yin kun zhig pa/ /de ni rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam la zhugs/ / zhes gsungs pa dang don gcig go /skabs 'di gnang ba la brten nas rje btsun red mda' bas kyang rje'i dgongs pa ltar rtogs pa yin te/ red mda' ba'i gsung las/ las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i yid ches dang*/ /rten 'brel stong pa rtogs pa'i shes rab gnyis/ /'bral med zung du 'jug pa nam chud pa/ /de tshe mtha' 'bras dbu ma'i lam la zhugs/ zhes dang*/ snang dus nyid nas stong par rtogs pa dang*/ /stong par rtogs tshe snang ba m-i 'gog pa'i/ /zung 'jug lam la nges pa nam skyes pa/ /de tshe rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rtogs pa yin/ /zhes dang*/ yang*/ rten 'brel btags pa tsam du go na don dam brjod bral nam mkha' ltar go ba'i nges pa skyes pas/ blo gzhan la ltos mi dgos par blo de nyid kyis sgro 'dogs chod pa'o/ /dper na/ sa phyogs dag par rtogs pa'i blo de nyid kyis bum med la sgro 'dogs chod pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de dang mthun par rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rten 'brel stod pa'i ṭik+kar yang*/ snang ba la nges shes drangs pa tsam gyis stong pa la nges shes je cher 'drongs pa cig dang*/ stong pa la nges shes drangs pa tsam gyis snang ba la nges shes je cher 'gro ba cig dgos te/ de 'dra zhig byung na stong pa rten 'brel gyi grogs sam don du shar ba zhes bya zhing rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi thugs kyi bcud bla na med pa 'phags pa klu sgrub yang sras kyis bkral ba'i gnad mthar thug pa yin mod/ rje btsong kha pa 'ba' zhig gi dgongs par snang ngo*/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/

/༈ de nas/ spyir chos kyi rnam grangs mang yang thar pa'i rgyur 'gro ba ni nges 'byung byang chub kyi sems lta ba rnam dag go /da lta 'di gsum la myong ba thon pa lta zhog go ba rnam dag yod pa yang dkon zhing*/ de la gsum gyi dang po nges 'byung dang byang chub kyi sems gnyis la go ba rnam dag yod pa tsam gyis thar pa'i sa bon 'jog mi nus kyang*/ phyi ma stong nying rtogs pa'i lta ba la go ba rnam dag yod na de stobs che bas sa bona'ajog nus/ go ba rnam dag lta ci don 'gyur gyi the tshom skyes pa tsam gyis kyang thar pa'i sa bon 'jog nus pa yin te/ 'phags pa lhas bsod nams chung ngus chos 'di la/ /the tshom za ba yang mi 'gyur/ /the tshom zos pa tsam gyis kyang*/ /srid pa hrul por byed par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dang po nges 'byung sems bskyed gnyis go ba tsam las

(mtshams 'di nas yi ge 'ga' chad pa'am yig lhag gang rung 'dug snyam) ma las bar yid 'gyur ba'i myong ba thon pas thar pa'i sa bon 'jog /de yang 'bad pa drag pos 'khor ba'i phun tshogs kyis bsdus pa'i sdug bden la dmigs nas rnam pa de dang 'bral 'dod yid la byed pa'i byed sgom yang yang byas pas goms pa'i mthus yid 'gyur pa na/ rtsol bcas kyi myong ba thon pa 'ong zhing nges 'byung yin pas/ des thar pa'i sa bon 'jog nus kyang lam gyi snar ma sleb po/ /lam gtso las/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' tshe la long med pa/ /yid la goms pas tshe 'di'i snang shas ldog /las 'bras mi slu 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rnams/ /yang yang bsams na phyi ma'i snang shas ldog /de ltar goms pas srid pa'i phun tshogs la/ /yid smon skad cig tsam yang mi skye zhing*/ /nyin mtshan kun tu thar pa don gnyer blo/ /byung na de tshe nges 'byung skyes pa lags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ srid pa'i bde 'byor dran tsam gyis nges 'byung rtsol med du skye na nyan rang gi rigs can yin na'ang lam gyi sne zin kyang*/ theg chen gyi rigs can yin na sems can gyi sdug bsngal dran tsam gyis byang sems rgyun ldan du 'jug pa'i myong ba thon na theg chen gyi tshogs lam chung ngur 'jog /de yang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sdug bsngal dang thar ba'i phan yon mthong ba'i dran shes sna re rgyun ldan du bsten nas snang shas la blo 'gror mi ster bar srid pa'i skyon mtshang bcar ba ste rig cing 'gog pa dang*/ thar ba'i phan yon la sems 'dzin pa'i dmigs rnam goms nas nges 'byung la myong ba 'don dgos shing*/ de la myong ba ma bton par sbyin pa nas bsam gtan gyi bar dge rtsa gang goms kyang thar ba'i rgyur gtan nas mi 'gro bas thar 'dod kyi gdul byas/ nyams len gyi thog mar sngags la sogs pa'i gdams ngag gang zab zer ba gzhan thams cad re zhig bzhag nas nges 'byung la rtog bsgom ste/

dpyad bsgom bya dgos so zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'dir nges 'byung gi rnam gzhag cung zad bshad pa gnyis/ dngos dang*/ dogs gcod do/ /dang po la/ 'dir nges 'byung zhes pa ni nges 'byung gi blo yin la/ nges par 'byung ba ni thar pa yin te/ mdo rtsar/ nges par 'byung ba tshul khrims kyi dbang du byas te zhes pa'i rtsa 'grel las de ltar du bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /de la khyad par can dang*/ phal pa gnyis yod pa'i gnyis ka'ang sdug bden la dmigs nas skye ba yin te/ nyams mgur las/ sdug bden nyes dmigs bsams la ma 'bad na/ /thar ba don gnyer ji bzhin mi skye zhing*/ /zhes dang*/ lam rim che chung du'ang de bzhin du bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang tshe 'di'i snang shas mngon 'gyur ba dang phyi ma'i snang shas gnyis ka 'gog pa'i tshul gyis 'khor ba spyi las thar 'dod kyi blo bskyed dgos te/ bye brag pa ngan song gi sdug bsngal las thar 'dod tsam ni nges 'byung skye ba'i rgyu yin yang nges 'byung gi blo mtshan nyid tshang ba ma yin pa'i phyir te/ bde 'gro tsam gyi bde ba la gtso bor sred pa yang 'khor ba 'ching ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir te/ lam gtsor/ srid la brkam pa yis kyang lus can rnams/ /kun nas 'ching phyir/ zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na skyes bu 'bring gi skabs su bshad pa'i bde 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam tshul de nges 'byung skye ba'i thabs khyad par can yin te/ de yang lam rim chen po las/ thar ba zhes pa ni bcings pa las grol ba ste/ de yang las dang nyon mongs pa gnyis ni 'khor bar 'ching byed yin la/ de gnyis kyi dbang gis khams kyi dbang gis 'dod khams sogs gsum dang*/ 'gro bas phye na lha la sogs pa lnga'am drug dang*/ skyes gnas kyi sgo nas mngal la sogs pa bzhir phung po nyid mtshams sbyar ba ni bcings pa'i ngo bo yin pas/ de las 'grol ba ni thar ba'o/ /de thob par 'dod pa ni thar ba don gnyer gyi blo'o/

/zhes pa nas/ thar ba don gnyer bskyed pa'i thabs la gnyis/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gi sgo nas bsams pa dang*/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas bsam pa'o zhes mdor bstan nas rgyas par 'chad pa na/ dang po la sdug bsngal la brgyad dang*/ drug dang*/ gsum bsgom tshul dang*/ kun 'byung la mi dge ba bcu dang rtsa nyon gyi rnam gzhag rgyas par 'chad cing*/ de nas rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi rnam gzhag kyang rgyas par bshad par ltar ro/ /rten 'brel gyi nyams len kyang sdug kun gyi nyams len du 'du ba yin te/ ji skad du/ dang po brgyad pa dgu nyon mongs/ /gnyis pa bcu pa las yin te/ /lhag ma bdun ni sdug bsngal yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bcom ldan 'das kyis bden bzhi'i rnam gzhag mdzad pa ni 'khor ba las thar ba'i thabs kyi snying po bsdus nas bstan par go bar bya'o/ /'khor ba las thar 'dod dang*/ thar ba don gnyer gyi blo dang*/ nges 'byung gi blo rnams ming gi rnam grangs yin la/ de skyes pa'i tshad ni/ lam rim chen mor/ bsam pa de skyes pa'i tshad ni/ de ltar sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gnyis dang rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid zhib tu shes par byas nas/ de dag 'dor bar 'dod pa dang de rnams nye bar zhi ba la thob 'dod byung ba tsam nas nges 'byung gi bsam pa yin mod/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa la/ 'o na lam gtsor/ nyin mtshan kun tu thar ba don gnyer blo/ zhes gsungs pa ji ltar yin zhe na/ skyon med de/ de ni lam gyi sner sleb pa'i nges 'byung khyad par can la dgongs shing*/ de dang 'dir bshad pa'i rtsol med kyi myong ba thon pa'i nges 'byung yang de la dgongs par 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /nyin mtshan kun tu zhes/ gsungs kyang mtshan mo gnyid log pa'i dus lta bu la blo de mngon 'gyur ba yod mi dgos te/ rang cag lto gos don gnyer can dag la'ang gnyid dus sogs 'ga' zhig la de don gnyer mngon 'gyur du 'ong ba'i nges pa med pa bzhin no/

/spyir mdo sngags kyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya dbang rnon rgyud smin pa'i dbang du mdzad nas gsungs pas/ 'dul ba'i gzhung gi gdul bya'i gtso bo yang de lta bu zhig dgos pa yin pas nges 'byung khyad par can gyi dbang du mdzad pa yin mod/ da lta'i gdul bya'i dbang du byas na nges 'byung la gtso phal gnyis yod ces 'dod rigs te/ de yang gzhan la sdom pa 'bog pa lta bu'i skabs su mkhan slob sogs kyis 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang thar ba'i phan yon legs par brda sprad pa'i tshe go ba rags zhib gang rung zhig la brten nas 'khor ba las thar 'dod dang thar ba thob 'dod khyad par can nam/ min yang spam ye ba legs pa zhig skyes pas kyang nges 'byung gi go chod cing*/ sdom pa skye ba'i rten du yang 'gyur bar sems te/ tshul 'di ni rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po sogs 'ga' zhig kyang bzhed de 'thad par mngon no/ /nges 'byung khyad par can dang phal pa gnyis las sdom pa thob 'ong ba 'dra yang mchog dman yod par khas blangs pa la 'gal ba med de/ dper na dbang bskur ba'i tshe dbang thob pa tsam la 'dra yang*/ bskur mkhan dang zhu mkhan mchog dman gyis dbang thob tshul la mchog dman 'ong bar sngags rim las bshad pa bzhin no/ /gzhan du na da lta'i rab byung sogs la skur 'debs kyi log lta skye bar thal zhing mthar ci yang ma yin par khas len dgos par 'gyur ro/ /sngon dang da lta'i dus gnyis ji lta ba bzhin 'dra mi dgos te/ sngon 'bras bu bzhi thob pa dang*/ grub chen dpag tu med pa byung la/ da lta ni de 'dra dkon pa bzhin no/ ༈ /theg chen gyi dbang du byas na theg chen sgrub pa pos rang don kho na yid byed kyi skyon dang*/ gzhan don byed pa'i phan yon la dran shes thu re bsten nas theg chen sems bskyed la myong ba 'don pa'i dmigs rnam goms par ma byas na/ dge ba gzhan gang byas kyang theg chen gyi lam du mi 'gyur te/

de las gzhan du na dge rtsa rnams rang don kho na yid byed kyi dbang byas nas dman pa'i rgyu 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ dper na nges 'byung la dran shes bsten pa'i dmigs rnam goms par ma byas na/ dge ba thams cad snang shas kyi dbang byas nas 'khor ba 'ba' zhig gi rgyu byed pa bzhin no/ /rgyu mtshan des na sngags la sogs pa'i gdams ngag gang zab zer ba rnams re zhig bzhag nas thog mar nges 'byung dang byang chub kyi sems la myong ba thon pa re nges par bya dgos te/ nges 'byung dang byang chub kyi sems de skyes pa dang*/ de nas dge ba thams cad thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur dbang med du 'gro ba'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di gnyis ka'am gang rung gtso bor bsgom dgos pas 'di gnyis la sgom rin mi chog par byed pa ni lam gyi gnad gtan nas ma shes pa yin zhes rje btsun gsung ngo*/ /des na 'di gnyis dngos gnas sam rjes 'thun tsam zhig yin yang skye ba la 'bad dgos par rje nyid kyis bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /'dir sems bskyed kyi rnam gzhag cung zad bshad pa la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ dogs gcod do/ /dang po ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ theg chen sems bskyed ni/ sems can gzhan sdug bsngal las sgrol bar dam bcas pa'i sgo nas rang nyid kyi rdzogs byang thob 'dod kyi sems khyad par can zhig ste/ skye ba'i rgyu rkyen la gzhan du ma yod kyang*/ sems can sdug bsngal las skyob 'dod kyi snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs pa zhig nges par dgos so/ /sbyong tshul la sems can thams cad mar shes pa drin dran pa drin bzo ba byams pa snying rje lhag bsam sems bskyed de rgyu 'bras bdun dang*/ bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sgo nas sbyong tshul gnyis dang*/ dbye na smon 'jug gi sems gnyis so/

/skyes pa'i tshad ni/ gzhan don don gnyer gyi blo la bcos min gyi myong ba thon pa'i rjes su byang chub don gnyer gyi blo la bcos min gyi myong ba nam thon pa'i tshe de skyes par 'jog ste/ rnam bshad sogs las gzhan don don gnyer gyi 'dun pa rgyu dang*/ byang chub don gnyer gyi 'dun pa grogs su dgos par gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /sems bskyed yin pa tsam gyis theg chen sems bskyed yin mi dgos te/ rnam bshad snying po'i rgyan las/ sangs rgyas kyi sku mthong nas 'di lta bu thob na snyam pa dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi cho 'phrul dang mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mthong thos sogs dang*/ theg chen gyi bstan pa nub pa ma bzod nas sems bskyed pa gsum ni sems bskyed tsam yin par bshad de/ de nyid las/ gzhan gsum yang sangs rgyas don gnyer gyi sems bskyed tsam zhig yin mod/ zhes dang*/ lam rim las snga ma gnyis kyi dbang du mdzad nas/ de gnyis re re la'ang sems bskyed pa tsam gyi grangs su bgrang dgos la/ zhes gsungs pa ltar sems bskyed phal pa zhig yod de/ 'dis 'jug sdom dang sngags sdom gyi rten byed mi byed 'og tu 'chad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ lam rim chen mor/ nges 'byung dang sems bskyed dang bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba gsum po gang rung gis ma zin pa'i dge ba rnams las dmigs bsal re gnyis ma gtogs thams cad 'khor ba'i rgyur 'gro bar bshad de/ dmigs bsal ni zhing gi mthu la brten pa dang*/ thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur bsam pa thag pa nas bsngos pa'i dge rtsa lta bu la dgongs so/ /thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur tshig tsam gyis bsngos pa la nges pa med kyang*/ bsam pa thag pas bsngo ba la nges 'byung yod par gsal te/ de la thar ba thob 'dod dang sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi bsam pa zhig 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na theg chen sems bskyed la nges 'byung nges par yod par 'gyur ro zhe na/

bden te/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi sngon du nges 'byung gi bsam pa zhig nges par 'ong ba'i phy-ir te/ theg chen sems bskyed la ni sems can gzhan 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar bar byas nas rdzogs byang la 'god 'dod kyi bsam pa zhig sngon du 'gro dgos shing*/ de la rang nyid 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar 'dod zhig nges par 'ong ba'i phyir te/ rang nyid sdug bsngal las thar 'dod med na gzhan sdug bsngal las skyob 'dod 'ongs med pa'i phyir te/ spyod 'jug las/ rang gi don du 'di 'dra'i sems/ /rmi lam du yang ma rmis na/ /gzhan gyi don du ga la skye/ /zhes dang*/ 'khor ba la yang skyo ba med na thar 'dod kyi blo yang mi skye ste/ bzhi brgya par/ gang la 'di skyo yod min pa/ /de la zhi gus ga la yod/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phy-i+ir/ kha cig khyed sngar nges 'byung phal pa de so thar gyi sdom pa'i rten du rung bar khas blangs pa ltar/ gong gi sems bskyed phal pa de nyid 'jug sdom gyi rten du rung ngam zhe na/ 'di dka' mod kyang lam rim chen mo las/ sngon la sems bskyed pa dang sdom pa cho gas bzung nas de nas byang chub kyi sems sbyor ba'ang yod de/ zhes theg chen lam ma zhugs na myong ba cung zad skyes pa'i sems bskyed phal pa tsam la brten nas 'jug sdom len pa'i skabs zhig bshad pas/ de ltar na da lta'i gang zag phal cher de lta bu'i sems bskyed la brten nas 'jug sdom len pa dang*/ de la brten nas sngags sdom kyang skye bar shes te dpyod pa'i sgo tsam du smos pa yin pas dpyad par 'tshal lo/ /lam rim sogs las sngags dang phar phyin theg pa gnyis gang du 'jug kyang byang chub kyi sems bskyed dgos par bshad pa ni lam dngos kyi dbang du mdzad la/ sngags dang phar phyin gyi theg pa'i rigs can du 'gyur ba ni lam ma zhugs na'ang yod par lung rigs kyis bsgrub nus par sems te/

gzhan du na da lta'i gsang sngags pa thams cad kyang lam zhugs su thal ba'am/ yang na ci yang ma yin par 'gyur ro/ /'o na/ sngar nges 'byung sogs gsum po gang rung gis ma zin na/ thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur m-i 'gro ba bshad pa ltar khas len cing 'thad na/ nyan rang gi lam rnams sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin pas sangs rgyas su 'gyur rung yin pa dang*/ sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya bar bshad pa dang mi 'gal lam zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ ring rgyu'i dbang du byas pa'i rgyu tsam yin yang*/ nye rgyu'am rgyu khyad par ba byang chub la mngon du phyogs pa'i rgyu ma yin pas de dag gi rgyur mi 'gyur zhes gsungs pa yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ sa bon gyi sta gon la gnas pa dang sa bon du btab pa ma yin pa'i de dag gi sngon gyi rgyud rgyu rnams la de dang de'i sa bon zhes mi brjod pa bzhin no/ /nges 'byung bsgom pa'i tshe srid pa'i phun tshogs la sred pa spang dgos par gsungs kyang yo byed 'ga' zhig dang zas gos don du gnyer ba tsam spong dgos pa min te/ dgra bcom pa dag la yang srid pa'i phun tshogs la sred zhen med kyang zas gos sogs don du gnyer ba yod pa mi 'gal ba'i phyir te/ dgra bcom pa pas gnas mal zas gos la yang bsten dgos pa'i phyir te/ lus rten 'tsho dgos shing tsha grang dang ngo tsha'i gnas las kyang srung dgos pa'i phyir/ tshangs pa dang rgya sbyin dang 'khor bsgyur dang rgyal phran sogs kyi stobs 'byor don du gnyer mi rung yang*/ rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i lha mi'i rten don du gnyer mi rung ba ma yin te/ lam rim bsdus don las/ /lam mchog sgrub la mtshan nyid tshang ba'i rten/ /ma rnyed bar du sa chod mi 'ong bas/ /de yi ma tshang med pa'i rgyu la bslab/ ces gsungs pa ltar lam rim che chung sogs las kyang 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ ༈ /de ltar nges 'byung sems bskyed gnyis kyis thog mar rgyud smin par byas nas grol bar byed pa'i lam la ni bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba btsal dgos te/

lta ba de ni rgyal ba kun gyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam med du mi rung ba yin pa'i phyir te/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ gal te bdag med chos la so sor rtog /ces sogs dang*/ sdud pa las/ rgyal ba 'das dang ma byon phyogs bcu gang zhugs pa/ /kun lam pha rol phyin pa 'di yin gzhan ma yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhi bar bgrod pa'i sgo gnyis pa gzhan med pa lta bu yin te/ de ltar du 'phags pa lhas/ zhi sgo gnyis pa med pa dang*/ zhes dang*/ rjes/ zhi sgo gnyis su med pa rten 'brel lam/ zhes dang*/ lam gtsor/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab mi ldan na/ nges 'byung byang chub sems la goms byas kyang*/ srid pa'i rtsa ba gcod par mi nus pas/ de phyir rten 'brel rtogs pa'i thabs la 'bad/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na thog mar bdag med rtogs pa'i mi rtogs ye shes sam zhi gnas spyi tsam zhig btsal te/ de la dran shes bsten nas/ gnas pa brtan po 'ong ba'i zhi gnas 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug gi spyod lam rnam bzhi dang bsre thub pa'i gnas pa brtan po zhig btsal bar bya la/ de rnyed pa na de nas lhag mthong sgom dgos te/ de yang sems kyi gnas cha zhig ma rnyed pa'i gong du lhag mthong bsgoms kyang rjes 'thun pa tsam ma gtogs sems 'phro drags pas lhag mthong dngos kyi myong ba mi thon/ spyir gnas cha tsam rnyed kyang thos pa rnam dag gi stobs kyis bdag med kyi don la nges shes 'drongs nges zhig med na/ bdag med rtogs pa'i lhag mthong gi myong ba rnam dag skye ba'i skabs med/ des na bdag med kyi don la gnas cha rnyed pa dang de nas de la brten nas lta ba la myong ba 'don dgos te/ de yang 'di ltar gzugs sgra sogs yul snang gzhan la'ang rang bzhin med par gtan la phab nas bsgoms na yang myong ba thon pa 'ong mod/ 'on kyang rtogs sla ba sogs kyi gnad du che ba ni dang por gang zag gi bdag ming rnam bdun gyi rigs pas btsal na mi rnyed pa'i bdag med de lta bu legs par rigs pas gtan la phab nas dpyad don ma rnyed pa dang de ka'i ngang la sems ma g.yeng ba'i dran shes bsten nas bzhag

/sems nam 'phro ba dang yang sngar bzhin rigs pas cung zad re dpyad cing btsal nas ma rnyed pa de ka'i ngang la bzhag ste/ dpyod pa 'di bar bar du ji ltar 'tshams pa zhig bya'i ha cang dpyad pa mang drags na 'phro shas che bar song nas lhag mthong la myong ba mi thon/ rnam pa bdun gyis 'tshol tshul ji ltar yin zhe na/ rgyas par ni bdag gis dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel ba dang*/ lta ba'i rnam gzhag tu bshad zin pas 'dir mtshon tsam zhig brjod na/ de ni 'jug pa las/ shing rta rang yan lag la gzhan 'dod min/ /gzhan min ma yin de ldan yang min zhing*/ /yan lag la min yan lag dag der min/ /'dus pa tsam min dbyibs min ji bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shing rta de rang gi yan lag rnams dang gcig dang tha dad dang ldan pa dang phan tshun brten pa gnyis dang tshogs pa dang dbyibs te bdun du rigs pas btsal na mi rnyed pa ltar/ bdag kyang rang gi phung po rnams dang dbyer med kyi gcig dang*/ 'brel med kyi tha dad dang*/ phung po rnams dang ngo bo nyid kyis ldan pa min la/ bdag phung po la ngo bo nyid kyis brten pa dang*/ phung po rnams bdag de la ngo bo nyid kyis brten pa ma yin zhing*/ phung po rnams kyi tshogs pa dang*/ dbyibs kyang bdag min pa ste rnam pa bdun du btsal na bdag mi rnyed do/ /de ltar shing rta rang gi yan lag la btags don rnam pa bdun du btags don btsal nas mi rnyed pa'i dpe ltar/ bdag kyang rang gi phung po la brten nas btags pa tsam las btags don bdun po der btsal nas ma rnyed pa'i tshe bdag rang bzhin med pa rnyed par 'gyur ba yin te/ drang nges rnam 'byed las/ shing rta rang gi yan lag dang gcig dang tha dang*/ ces pa nas/ 'di yang phung po la brten nas btags pa nyid kyis bdun po der gang zag mi rnyed pa ni gang zag gi bdag med pa'i don yin la/ zhes dang*/ 'jug pa las/ rnam pa bdun gyi med gang ji lta bur/ /yod ces rnal 'byor bas 'di'i yod mi rnyed/

/ces pa'i don 'chad pa na rje nor bzang rgya mtshos/ shing rta rang bzhin gyi yod na btags don rnam pa bdun du btsal nas rnyed dgos pa'i khyab pa nges pa byas pas rjes su rnam pa bdun du btsal bas ma rnyed pa de'i tshe/ shing rta rang bzhin med par nges pa yin te/ rigs pas dpyad nas ma rnyed pa de ci yang ma mthong ba'i tshul gyis de kho na nyid mthong ba yin no/ /zhes dang*/ dgongs pa rab gsal dang lam rim las kyang*/ sngar bshad pa'i rim pa 'di nyid kyis bdag dang shing rta 'di la sngar ltar rnam par dpyod pa na ches myur ba kho nar de kho na nyid kyi gting dpogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na/ shing rta dang bdag ji ltar 'jog ce na/ btags don ma btsal bar tha snyad tsam du 'jog pa yin te/ mdo las/ ji ltar yan lag tshogs rnams la/ /brten nas shing rtar brjod pa ltar/ /de bzhin phung po rnams rten nas/ /kun rdzob sems can zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang*/ 'jug pa las/ de ni de nyid du'ang 'jig rten du/ rnam pa bdun gyis 'grub 'gyur min mod kyi/ rnam dpyod med par 'jig rten nyid las 'di/ /rang gi yan lag brten nas 'dogs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pa'i phyir ro/ /shing rta dang gang zag la bshad pa bzhin du/ cha shas dang cha can/ tshogs pa dang tshogs pa can/ yan lag dang yan lag can/ yon tan dang yon tan can sogs gzhan dag la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /gcig tu bral gyi rtags la brten nas bdag rang gzhin med par rtogs pa'i dus ni rjes tsa shi'i ṭika chen las/ de ltar rang gi ngo bos grub na bdag dang phung po gnyis rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa'i gcig dang tha dad gang rung du grub dgos pa dang*/ de gnyis ka la rigs pas gnod pa mthong ba na bdag ni rang gi ngo bos grub pa cung zad kyang med do snyam du nges pa rnyed pa ni/ 'jig lta lhan skyes kyi yul rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i lta ba rnyed pa yin no/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /tshul 'di la/ gong ru rgyal mtshan pas/ phyogs chos bden grub kyi gcig dang tha dad gang rung du ma grub par rtogs pa tsam gyis bden med rtogs par bzhed cing*/ mkhas grub rjes/ de bden med sgrub pa'i rtags yin pas de tsam gyis bden med rtogs par mi bzhed/ rje nor bzang pas/ gcig du bral sogs kyi rigs pas dpyad cing de ltar dpyad pa las dpyad don la nges shes tshad ma skyes pa de'i tshe/ myu gu sogs rten 'byung ba'i chos rnams rang bzhin gyis ma grub par rtogs pa yin/ zhes gsung*/ lta ba rnyed nas skyong ba'i tshe dgag bya bkag tsam gyi med dgag la blo ci nus su mnyam par 'jog cing*/ blo'i shugs zhan du song na slar yang dgag bya'i snang tshul gsal btab nas tshul de ltar du grub pa med snyam pa ni lta ba skyong tshul dngos yin rje shes rab sed+ge dang*/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i sogs mang posabazhed pa ltar ro/ /gzugs sogs kyi chos gang yang don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs pa yang dag gis dpyad cing btsal ba'i tshe dpyad don mi rnyed la/ ma rnyed pa ni gzugs sogs bden grub tu ma rnyed pa yin zhing*/ der ma zad gzugs sogs kyang ma rnyed la/ 'on kyang gzugs sogs med par rnyed pa ni min no/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan de cha thams cad nas byad bzhin gyis stong ba ltar/ gzugs sogs kyang don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs pas dpyad na gang snang gi cha thams cad nas snang ba ltar rang bzhin gyis stong par nges par 'ong bas stong cham gyis 'gro la/ de'i tshe da ni ci yang mi 'dug go snyam pa 'byung bas skrag pa chen po skye ba'i gnas yod do/ /de ni mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i skyong tshul lo/ /de nas lhag mar ci zhig lus 'dug snyam nas bltas pas rjes thob tu gzugs sogs rnams sgyu ma tsam mam/ ming du btags pa tsam dang*/ brda dang tha snyad du btags pa tsam zhig lhag mar lus par mthong ngo*/

/de ltar yang bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel pa las/ de'i phyir de ltar yongs su dpyad pa na/ dngos po rnams kyi rang bzhin 'grub par mi 'gyur bas so so nas dngos po rnams la sgyu ma lta bu de nyid lhag mar lus par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sgyu ma dper byed pa ni/ lam rim las/ dper na sgyu ma'i rta glang snang ba mig gis shes pas mthong ba dang*/ snang ba ltar gyi rta glang med par yid kyi shes pas nges pa la brten nas rta glang du snang ba de sgyu ma lta bu brdzun pa'i snang bar nges pa skye ba de bzhin du/ gang zag la sogs pa tha snyad pa'i shes pa la bsnyon du med par snang ba dang*/ de nyid rang gi ngo bos grub pa'i rang bzhin gyis stong bar rigs shes kyis nges pa gnyis la brten nas gang zag de sgyu ma'am brdzun pa'i snang ba skye ba yin no/ /zhes dang*/ de bzhin du chos gzhan kun la'ang sbyor te/ bstod par/ rang bzhin gyis ni gdod ma nas/ / rnam par dben yang der snang bas/ /'di kun sgyu ma bzhin du gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ni rigs stobs kyis sgyu ma lta bur 'char tshul yin la/ rang bzhin med pa la nges pa drangs rjes dbang shes dang yid shes la yul snang thams cad lam lam/ hril hril/ ling ling nge bas snang ba shar tsam nas dran shes gyis de ltar du grub pa med snyam pa ni/ dran stobs kyis sgyu ma lta bu'i 'char tshul dang*/ dran tshul sngon ma gnyis la myong ba thon pa na phyis yul snang gang shar yang snang ba ltar grub pa med snyam du 'byung ba ni myong stobs kyis sgyu ma lta bu'i 'char tshul lo/ /de ltar mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i nyams len dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu bgrod dgos te/ lam rim bsdus don las/ mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i stong nyid dang*/ /rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i stong pa gnyis/

/bsgoms nas thabs shes zung du 'brel ba yis/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i pha rol 'gro ba bsngags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /༈ de nas da lta'i gdams ngag pa rnams las kha cig 'dod pa ltar sems cir yang mi rtog par bzhag nas lta bas gnas lugs cir yang tha snyad gdags sa med par gtan la phab pa dang gnyis bsres nas skyong lugs ci yang yid la mi byed par sems hang nger 'jog pa 'dis sems gnas tsam ma gtogs lhag mthong la myong ba thon pa mi srid ces rje btsun gsungs pas/ gnas pa rnyed nas bsgoms pa tsam gyis mi mchog gi mtshan nyid theg pa nas gsungs pa'i dpyad sgom ma byas na stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba la myong ba mi thon pas dpyad sgom bya dgos so/ /dpyad sgom yang sngar bshad pa ltar bar bar du dpyad nas sgom pa yin gyi/ 'ga' zhig ltar rgyun par bsam blo 'ba' zhig gtong ba yang ma yin/ gnas cha ma btsal bar lta ba skyong ba yang min/ des na da lta'i sgom chen gyi gnas pa skyong lugs sngar bshad pa ci yang mi sems pa 'di gtan nas lta ba'i lam gyi ngo bo dngos min zhes rje btsun gsung*/ de ltar brjod pa'i 'di rnams rje btsun pa rang re dang mthun shas che bas zur tsam smos dang nges shes rngam can 'drongs pa'i gnas mchi/ nged kyi yid la thal 'gyur lugs kyis gnas lugs sgom pa dang lta ba sgom pa khyad mi snang bas rung la/ rang rgyud pa phyin la stong nyid kyi lta ba sgom lugs 'di la ngo bo'i sgom lugs 'ong sa ye mi 'dug snyam nas rje btsun la zhus pas/ phyi ma rang rgyud pa man la stong nyid kyi lta ba dngos gnas ngo bo'i sgom lugs med pa de ga yin par 'dug ste/ thal 'gyur ba ltar na rang rgyud pa man chad la stong nyid rtogs pa med pa'i phyir te/ de man chad dngos por rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dod cing*/ de 'dod pa'i grub mtha' ma dor ba de srid du dngos po rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i gnas med pa'i phyir te/

mgon po klu sgrub lugs kyi dngos po rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i lta ba ma rnyed bar du zhi ba myang 'das thob pa'i thabs kyi gtso bor gyur pa'i lta ba med pa'i phyir te/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyi lam las ni/ phyi rol gyur la zhi ba'i thabs med do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na de dag gis bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba khas len kyang*/ bdag med phra mo rtogs par khas len mi dgos so/ /thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyis kyang stong nyid sgom pa'i 'jug sgom kho na de ltar du byas nas bsgoms na stong nyid la dmigs pa'i zhi gnas sam sems gnas skyong ba rkyang bar 'gyur gyi/ lhag mthong la ni nges par dpyad sgom bya dgos zhes rje btsun gsung*/ skabs 'di dag tu sems gnas zhes yang yang 'byung ba ni zhi gnas la dgongs shing*/ de yang spyir ji snyed pa la dmigs pa'i zhi lhag so so dang zung 'brel gnyis tshogs lam du ma zad/ lam ma zhugs dang phyi rol ba la'ang yod cing*/ ji lta ba la dmigs pa'i lhag mthong ni sbyor lam nas thob kyi/ de ma thob pa la med ces rnam bshad snying po'i rgyan las bshad do/ /zhi gnas sgrub tshul la/ sems gnas dgu /stobs drug /yid byed bzhi yod de/ dang po dgu ni 'jog pa dang yang dag par 'jog pa dang bsdus te 'jog pa dang nye bar 'jog pa dang dul bar byed pa dang zhi bar byed pa dang nye bar zhi bar byed pa dang rgyud gcig tu byed pa dang ting nge 'dzin du byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa drug ni/ thos pa'i stobs dang de bzhin du bsam pa dang dran pa dang shes bzhin dang brtson 'grus dang yongs su 'dris pa'o/ /gsum pa bzhi ni bsgrims te 'jug pa dang 'chad cing 'jug pa dang 'chad med du 'jug pa dang rtsol med du 'jug pa'i yid byed do/ /zhi lhag gi bshad pa rgyas par ni lam rim du gsal ba ltar te 'dir mang du dogs so/ /mdor na ci yang yid la mi byed par sgom pa de dag gis bsam tshod ni/

dngos po'i gnas lugs ci yang min pa'i stong ba dang blos ci yang mi 'dzin pa gnyis mthun par 'dug snyam du bsam pa dang*/ mdo rgyud rnams su ci yang mi sgom pa gnas lugs bsgom par gsungs lta bu mang du byung ba rnams kyis 'khrul gzhi byas nas/ ci yang yid la mi byed pa sgra rtog bkag pa'i sgom tsam la gnas lugs sgom par 'khrul 'dug go /de ltar 'dod pa 'di gtan nas mi rigs te/ mdo rgyud rnams su ci yang mi sgom pa gnas lugs bsgom par gsungs shing*/ de'i phan yon nam bsngags pa dpag tu med pa zhig kyang gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ni/ yid byed bkag pa'i sgom de lta bu la min gyi/ sgra rtog tsam ma yin par gzung 'dzin gyi rtogs pa'i gnyis snang mtha' dag dag pa ste nub nas rnams grangs ma yin pa'i don dam bden pa dang de nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag gi blo gnyis chu la chu bzhag pa bzhin du dbyer med du song ba'i mnyam bzhag gi skabs la dgongs pa'i phyir te/ so skye la rnam grangs ma yin pa'i don dam don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa yod kyang*/ don dam de dang blo gnyis chu la chu zhugs pa ltar ro gcig tu song ba'i don mthun pa gtan nas med pa'i phyir te/ so skye gnas lugs la skog tu gyur pa'i phyir dang*/ sgra rtog bkag pa'i sgom tsam gyi gnas lugs de yul du byar mi nus pa'i phyir dang*/ so skye'i shes pa rtog med kyis gnas lugs yul du byar mi nus shing*/ gal te mngon du byas na mngon gyur du mngon du byed dgos pas 'phags par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs pa'i so skye ni med de/ byams mgon gyi rgyud bla ma las/ gang phyir gzugs la dmus long bzhin/ /byis pas de sngon mthong ma myong*/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnams grangs ma yin pa'i don dam la gnyis yod kyang 'dir don dam bden pa dngos gnas la de skad ces brjod pa ste/

rnam grangs kyi don dam ni yul bden stong sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ yul can bde med rtogs pa'i rjes dpag lta bu'o/ /rgyu mtshan gong du brjod pa des na/ rnam grangs ma yin pa'i don dam la so skye'i mngon sum rtog med kyi shes pas nyams len bya mi nus pas/ rtog med mngon sum gyis rnam grangs ma yin pa'i don dam la nyams len bya tshul gsungs pa de 'phags pa la dgongs pa yin la/ nyams len de la 'jug pa'i thabs su da lta nas rten 'brel rang bzhin med pa dang bden pas stong pa sogs la gnas lugs su rtog pas don spyi'i tshul du zhen nas dpyad sgom gyis zhugs pas/ rnam grangs ma yin pa'i don dam bden pa dang chu la chu bzhag bzhin ro gcig tu song ba'i 'phags pa'i rtog med kyi ye shes thob par 'gyur zhes rje btsun gsung*/ des na 'jog sgom du ma zad lta bas gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs na yang*/ rnam grangs yin pa'i don dam mngon sum du gzigs par gyur ba'i gzigs ngo ltar byed na/ mdo las/ stong pa nyid la gzugs med/ tshor ba med ces sogs dang*/ sdud pa las/ gzugs rnams mi mthong tshor ba dag kyang mi mthong zhing*/ /zhes sogs dang*/ gang tshe 'dus byas 'dus ma byas dang dkar nag chos/ /shes rab rnam par gshig nas rdul tsam mi dmigs tshe/ /zhes sogs dang*/ mgon pos/ spros pa nyer zhi zhi bstan pa/ /zhes dang*/ zhi ba lhas/ gang tshe dngos dang dngos med pa/ /blo yi mdun na mi gnas pa/ /de tshe dngos med rten bral bas/ /dmigs pa med pas rab tu zhi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gzigs ngo der gnyis snang gi spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi bas gnyis snang nub pa ltar gang gis bshad nas gang gis nyan sus go /dper na/ bya nam mkha' la bgrod pa'i rjes ni 'jig rten pa'i rgan po brda la byang bas kyang ji lta ba bzhin ston mi nus pa ltar te/ sa bcu ba'i mdo las/ ji ltar bar snang bya rjes mkhan rnams kyis/

/brjod par nus ma yin zhing ma mthong ltar/ /de bzhin rgyal ba'i sras kyi sa kun kyang*/ brjod mi nus ni nyan par ga la nus/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin dang*/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yang de lta bu la dgongs kyi/ spyir don dam bden pa ni sgras brjod nus shing bsam nus pa yang yin no/ /dpe gzhan yang*/ bu ram gyi ro myong ba skyes bu rang gis ro ji ltar myang ba'i tshul de ji lta ba bzhin du gzhan la 'chad pa dang*/ gzhan gyis myang ba ltar go mi nus pa de bzhin du don dam gzigs pa pos kyang rang gis ji ltar gzigs pa'i gnyis snang nus pa'i spros bral ltar gzhan la ston mi nus pa yin te/ 'chad nyan kun la spros bcas nges par 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang lta ba 'tshol ba'i tshe rtog pas lta ba'i go yul btsal dgos/ 'tshol ba de ma byas na lta ba ji lta ba bzhin nges pa gar srid de mi srid/ des mtshon nas gzhan bshad rgyu dpag tu med pa yod kyang bzhag rgyu mtshan de'i phyir thal 'gyur ba'i 'phags pa chen po stong nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa rnams la mnyam gzhag gi tshe na kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag gam khas len thams cad zhig pas de rnams kyi ngor mnyam bzhag dang khyad med/ mnyam gzhag las langs pa na de dag gi rjes thob na kun rdzob rten 'brel gyi gzugs brnyan nam snang ba sgyu ma lta bu dgag tu med par 'char ba/ so skye thal 'gyur bas kyang da lta nas rang bzhin med pa'i rten 'brel sgyu ma'am gzugs brnyan lta bu tha snyad du nges pa rang lugs la yang 'dod cing khas len dgos/ de khas blangs kyang re zhig la skyon du mi 'gyur zhing*/ de dgag tu yang mi nus pas khas blangs dgos te/ snang stong gnyis la spyir nye ring mi rung zhing*/ so skyes snang ba la lhag par rtsis su bya dgos zhes rje btsun gsung*/ kha cig rgyu 'bras sogs kyi kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag rnams gzhan dor khas len gyi/

rang lugs la khas mi len zer ba ltar ni mi rung ste/ gzhan ngor khas len pa la ni nges pa ci yang med pa'i phyir te/ de la phyi rgol gyi bsnyam pa la brtags nas des khas blangs pa'i tshul la ltos nas kho'i 'dod pa phyin ci log sun dbyung dgos pas/ de la ni rgyang pan par bcad kyi grub mtha' la ltos nas re zhig de'i ngor 'di khas len dang 'di khas mi len med do/ /de yang kho bos sgra rtag par khas len pa na 'o na nged kyis bum pa yang rtag par khas len no zhes kho gang 'dod pa'i log phyogs sgra mi rtag par rang lugs dang*/ bum pa rtag par re zhig blangs nas mgo mtshungs sogs byas pas/ mthar kho'i 'dod pa la gnod byed mthong ba dang*/ rang lugs su sgra mi rtag par dam bca' bzhag pa de yang bum pa mi rtag pa de dang 'dra'o/ /zhes bstan la/ rang gi dgos pa'i dbang gis khas blangs par bstan pas khas blangs gnyis ka mnyam pa'am mtshungs par 'gro /rang lugs kyi khas blangs de gzhan ngor khas blangs pa tsam yin gyi ngas khas ma blangs zer mi btub ste/ yin nam min yang rang gzhan gyi phyogs gnyis kas gang khas blangs pa de la skyon gnod byed ma mthong gi bar du rang rang gi zhe 'dod yin pa bzhin byed dgos pa lta bu yin zhes rje btsun gsung*/ gong du bshad pa ltar gang zag gi bdag med la dpyad sgom gyi myong ba thon pa dang*/ de nas chos kyi bdag med kyi dmigs rnam du ma la brtson 'grus kyis 'bad cing rtsal sbyang ngo*/ /lugs 'dir bdag med gnyis 'jog tshul ni/ 'jug pa las/ bdag med 'di ni 'gro ba rnam grol phyir/ /chos dang gang zag dbye bas rnam gnyis gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khyad gzhi gang zag gi steng du dgag bya rang bzhin gyis grub pa bkag pa gang zag gi bdag med dang*/ phung sogs kyi steng du rang bzhin gy-is grub pa bkag pa chos kyi bdag med du 'jog pa tsam yin gyi/ bdag med gnyis la phra rags kyi khyad par med do/

/'on kyang lam rim chung ba las/ khyad gzhi'i gnad kyi gang zag gi steng du rtogs sla bar bshad/ chos kyi bdag med gtan la 'bebs pa'i rigs pa'i gtso bo ni rten 'brel gyi rigs pa yin te/ 'jug pa las/ de phyir rten 'byung rigs pa 'di yis ni/ /lta ngan dra ba mtha' dag gcod par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar rgyu 'bras sogs kyi chos mtha' gnyis gi steng du rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis 'gog nus shing*/ bstod par yang*/ de nyid mkhas la spros pa yi/ /dra ba ma lus gcod pa'i sgo/ /zhes gsungs pa yang rten 'brel gyi rigs pa la dgongs pa'i phyir ro/ /klu sgrub dang zla bas rtsa she dang 'jug par/ mtha' bzhi skye 'gog gi rigs pa bshad la de yang rten 'brel gyi rigs pa la thug ste rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya zhing 'ga' zhig gong du brjod zin to/ ༈ /'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud sogs nas stong nyid kyi lta ba bstan pas sngags kyi rdzogs rim pa lta ba sgom pa'i tshul yod kyang*/ de rnams la mtshan nyid kyi gzhung nas bshad pa'i lta ba'i myong ba 'don lugs 'di med pas/ sngags kyi de rkyang ba byas na lta ba'i go yul tsam yod kyang lta ba'i lam khyad par can du gtan mi 'gro /bde gsal mi rtog pa'i khyad chos gsum ldan gyi nyams mchog tu 'gyur ba skyes nas skabs der sgra rtog gi spros pa gtan mi rgyu ba'am/ rgyu yang zhi gnas kyi gnas cha stobs ches pas g.yo ba'i rtog pa gcig nas gcig tu mtshams sbyor mi thub par spros pa'i dmigs gtad zhig pa yin nam snyam byed pa dang*/ yang yul snang thams cad sgyu ma ltar 'char ba yang 'ong mod/ de'i tshe sgra rtog de dag gnas cha ches pa'i zhi gnas kyi mthus re zhig bkag pa'i dmigs gtad zhig pa 'dra ba zhig byung ba yin gyi/ mnyam gzhag gi ngo bo ni gnyis snang gi rtog pa las ma 'das pa'i phyir sgra rtog gi spros pa 'di gtan nas 'jig mi thub/

sgra rtog gi spros pa rags pa re zhig log pa dang snang ba sgyu ma ltar 'char ba de 'dra bsam gtan bzhi thob na yang 'ong zhing*/ de thob nas gzugs sogs yul lnga'i snang ba thams cad mnyam par bzhag pa na na bun ltar snang ba yang 'ong*/ bsam gtan thob pa'i tshe de 'ong bar ma zad/ gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug thob nas mnyam gzhag gi tshe gzugs kyi snang ba rnams 'gags nas kyang 'gro ba 'ong ste/ de 'dra 'ong ba de ni lhag mthong gi mthu min gyi zhi gnas kyi stobs kyis yin no/ /yul gyi snang tshul de ltar snang ba byung yang nang rang rgyud kyi myong rig nyams rtogs la stong nyid rtogs so snyam pa'i brod pa ste dga' spro 'dir mi nus shing mi rung ste/ stong nyid kyi lta ba la myong ba ma thon pas so/ /gsang sngags kyi lam myur bar bshad pa ni zhi gnas khyad par can yod pas myur ba dang*/ de yang zhi gnas stobs ldan sgrub lugs lha dang rtsa rlung thig le sogs la dmigs rten byed pa mtshan nyid theg pa la med pa rnams yod la/ de'i tshe zhi gnas ci tsam stobs che ba bzhin lta bas zin pa na lta ba la myong ba stobs ldan 'grub sa yod pas sngags lam myur bar bshad pa yin no/ / ji skad bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan des na mtshan nyid theg pa'i lam gyi gnad lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gong du bstan pa rnams kyang shes/ de'i steng du sngags kyi thabs lam gyi gdams ngag byang yod pa klu sgrub dang zla ba grags pa 'dra ba de mtshan nyid kyi theg pa rkyang ba'i gdul bya las lam ches myur ba dang ches khyad par du 'phags pa yin gyi/ mtshan nyid kyi lam gyi gnad khyad par can med pa'i sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul bya de mtshan nyid kyi gdul bya las dman te/ gang zag des sngags lam de kho na la brten nas 'tshang rgya bar mi nus shing*/ mtshan nyid kyi de de kho na la brten nas 'tshang rgya nus pas so/ /de ltar thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi dbang du byas nas mtshan nyid kyi theg pa mchog dang*/

sngags 'dod yon la spyod pa'i nyon mongs kyi dbang du song drags nas rgyud ma dag pa'i gdul bya la mngon mtho'i thabs tsam dang*/ zhi gnas sogs tsam bstan pas dman pa yin zhes rje btsun gsung*/ mtshan nyid theg pa kho na la brten nas 'tshang rgya nus mi nus la dpyad par bya ba mang du yod kyang bzhag 'di dag ni gang la dgongs nas gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi da dung btsal dgos pa ltar snang yang*/ 'di rnams thams cad la rjes rje btsun la dgag sgrub dpag med byas nas zhu gtugs byas shing gzhan du ma yod kyang brir ma lang zhes gsungs pa 'di ltar na/ 'di skor rnams sgras zin ltar khas blangs dgos rgyur snang ngo*/ /'di thams cad red mda' ba rang re la nges shes 'dren pa'i rgyu 'gro ngo shes snyam nas rjes bris pa yin/ 'di skor la rje nga la ni yin nam min snyam pa'i the tshom gyi dri tsam yang med de/ the tshom kun chod pa'i phyir ro zhes gsung*/ de yan ni dngos gzhi'o/ /༈ de nas zhal ta zhus pas zhes pa man chad ni 'phros sam zhar byung du snang bas tshig 'grel rgyas mi dgos par mthong bas bsdus te bshad na/ 'di dag rje btsun la zhus nas bskur zhig ces re mda' bas zhus pa dang*/ rjes kyang rang re mjal 'dzom bgyid ba ma byung ba khyad che snyam nas bris pa lags zhes phul ba'i rgyu mtshan nam dgos pa dang*/ de nas lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum la myong ba 'don tshul khyad par can 'di 'dra da lta gzhan su la'ang 'chad rgyu mi 'dug pas/ bris nas bskur ba 'di dag khyad par can yin no/ shes shing nyams su len pa gal che tshul dang*/ thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyi lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum la 'khrid tshul rgyas par gnang ba yod pa dag 'dir ma bris shing*/ yi ge bris nas bskur ba 'di dag kyang mi slu ba yin zhing*/ mi slu ba yin nges pa'i rgyu mtshan bslus na nga'i mig tu sgog chu brdungs chog cesagasungs pa dang*/

de nas red mda' ba sgrub pa la bskul ba'i skor de rnams dang*/ red mda' ba nyid rje btsun gyis sgrub pa la bskul zhing bsgrubs pas 'grub na 'di skor gyi nyams su len tshul zhus nas nga la bskur zhig dang nged kyang de dang mthun mi mthun blta gsungs ba dang*/ 'chad nyan byed pa dag la 'di dag gi bshad pa snang yang*/ zhe thag pa nas 'khrid du bcug na yid gtan dka' bar snang ba dang*/ nyams len pa dag la lam gyi gtso bo gsum po thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo'am rtsa bar 'dug pa la/ de rang rgyud la nyams su len pa'i myong ba mi 'don par nges 'byung dang sems bskyed gnyis kyi go ba tsam la myong ba thon par 'khrul ba dang*/ kha cig sngon du 'di gnyis la myong ba mi 'don par rtsa rlung thig le sogs kyi dmigs pa la zab par 'khrul nas 'jug 'ga' zhig rgyud la nyams su len kyang 'di gnyis kyi go ba rnam dag ma rnyed par 'di dag ltar snang re la mtshan nyid tshang bar 'khrul nas 'bad/ yang*/ la la sngar bshad pa ltar lta ba'i go ba mi 'tshol bar sems cir yang mi rtog pa'i sgra rtog bkag pa tsam gyi sgom la lta ba rnam dag sgom par 'dzin/ kha cig gong ma'i sas bsdus kyi zhi gnas lta zhog /'dod sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhi gnas rjes 'thun pa tsam la'ang gnas lugs bsgom par 'khrul snang ste/ 'dod sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni zhi gnas ma thob gong gi sems gnas dgu pa man chad kyi ting nge 'dzin rnams yin la/ zhi gnas thob phyin gong ma'i sas bsdus kyi ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur ro/ /mkhas pa drag shos kha cig de tsam mi 'dod kyang lta ba'i go yul skam po phyogs mthun tsam zhig sngar gyi ting nge 'dzin de la bskon pa ste bsres nas bsgoms pas de la mi zhen par 'dod pa dang*/ sgom de'i thog mthar sems bskyed smon lam yid 'khul nges min pa'i tshig tsam kha yar byas pas lam dngos gnas par 'gro snyam pa 'dug kyang*/

nges 'byung sems bskyed gnyis la myong ba ma thon par thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur mi 'gro ba sngar bzhin dang*/ sems tsam pa dang dbu ma pa gnyis po gang rung gi lta ba rnyed nas zhi gnas btsal te de nas dpyad sgom gyis lhag mthong la myong ba mthon na zhi lhag gzung 'brel gyi lam du mi 'gro ba dang*/ nyan bshad kyi dus su go ba thar ba'i rgyur 'gro ba yod tshul dang*/ 'on kyang nyan bshad la ni bstan pa'i snying po bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba mtshan nyid theg pa nas gsungs pa ltar shes par bya dgos/ de mi byed par gzhan gyi zer sgros nyag nyog mang po spyi dang*/ khyad par du rtsis sogs tha snyad kyi skor dang cho ga'i spras spros dang rtsa rlung sogs kyi gtam mang po la 'bad pa ni don chung ba dang*/ yang*/ gal chen bdag med kyi don la nges shes 'drongs pa'i sgrub pa byed dgos shing lta ba 'di'i go ba thar ba'i rgyur 'gro yang 'dis snang shas zil gyis gnon mi nus pas des skyon du 'gyur/ snang shes zil gyis gnon pa la nges 'byung gal che ba dang*/ 'di phyi'i snang shas kyi dbang byas pa'i dge rtsa rnams 'khor ba'i rgyur 'gro ba dang*/ bstan pa dang sems can phyogs 'di tsam du ma zad/ phyogs mtha' yas pa dang*/ yul dus mtha' yas pa'i rtsis btang dgos pa dang*/ de ltar btang na bsam pa rgya che ru 'gro zhing 'gro don yang rgya che ba dang*/ 'di rnams rje btsun gyi man ngag yid ches pa'i gnas yin zhing khyed la ni sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin bskyal ba yin pas don 'di bzhin nyams su blangs na/ red mda' ba nyid sku tshe 'di dang phyi ma la gzhan don khyad par can 'grub pa'i yon tan sogs 'thob par rje btsun gyis lung bstan pa rnams so/ /de nas mtha'i bsngo smon ni/ dge 'di'i mtshon nas dus gsum dang 'brel ba'i/ /zhes pa nas/ rnam dag smin pa'i gnas 'di 'grub par shog /ces pa'i bar tshigs bcad bzhi ste go sla'o/

/zhes pa 'di ni/ rje btsong kha pa chen pos rje btsun re mda' ba chen po sa skya na bzhugs pa'i drung du 'bul ba la rtog ldan byang seng pa grogs mched btang ba'i dus kyi zhu yig ngo bo las slob dpon kre bo thar bzang gis ji ltar bshus pa las phyi mo bgyis pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ 'di'i mjug tu bsngo smon gyi tshigs bcad yod pa 'di ltar na dbu na mchod brjod kyang yod par mngon te/ 'dir mi 'byung ba ni gong du brjod pa ltar ro/ /༈ yang gsung 'bum thor bu'i mjug tu rjes rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la zhus te red mda' par gnang ba zhig bzhugs pa 'di'i don go bde bas yongs su 'chad dgos pa mi 'dug kyang*/ sngar ma'i zhar byung du 'di'i don bsdus te brjod na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bya 'khor ba las thar ba'i thabs su mdo sngags gnyis gsung ba'i nang nas sngags lam la 'jug dgos te/ lam de ni tshe gcig gam/ bdun nam/ skye ba bcu drug lta bu la 'tshang rgya nus pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /kha cig sngags lam 'di lta bu rang dgar mthong nas dor te rigs lam tsam gtso bor don du gnyer ba ni myur du 'tshang rgya ba'i skal chad can no/ /de yang sngon du skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pas rgyud sbyangs dgos shing khyad par du lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum sngar bshad pa rnams rgyud la ci skye bya'o/ /lta ba yang mgon po klu sgrub kyis gsungs pa'i lta ba ci nus su 'tshol dgos/ tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya ba bla med kyi khyad chos yin pas bla med la pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis las pha rgyud kyi gtso bo ni gsang ba 'dus pa yin la/ 'dis sgyu lus dang 'od gsal gnyis ka ston cing*/ khyad par du sgyu lus rgyas par ston pas shes dgos so/ /ma rgyud bde dgyes nas bde stong gi ye shes gtso bor ston cing*/ de skyed pa'i thabs su gtum mo sbar dgos pas/ de ni bde dgyes gnyis dang kye rdor nas rgyas par 'chad/

bde mchog nas rtsa gnas rnams su dpa' bo dang dpa' mo bsgoms pas rtsa rlung rnams byin gyis brlabs nas rlung thim pas bde stong skye tshul sogs 'chad pas/ bde mchog gi skor la mkhas dgos/ de yang lhun po'i rtse na da lta yang dngos su bzhugs pas byin rlabs myur ro/ /gzugs sku'i rgyu'i gtso bo sgyu lus sgrub tshul gsang 'dus nas 'byung bas de la mkhas dgos shing*/ chos sku'i rgyu'i gtso bo bde stong gi ye shes ni bde mchog gis ston pas de la sbyangs dgos la/ de yang lo nag dril gsum gyi gzhung ltar shes dgos/ rgya bod gnyis su bde mchog la brten pa'i grub chen shin tu mang po byon shing da lta yang rnal 'byor byed pa mang*/ bde gsang gnyis kyi sgo nas lam bgrod pa la yi dam 'jigs byed la bsten dgos te/ 'dis lam sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen spyi dang khyad par du gdon 'gegs sogs kyi gnod pa zhi nas lam mthar phyin par 'gyur ro/ /'jigs byed kho rang la yang khyad chos lnga yod de/ gcig ni phyag mtshan sgyu mas ni sgyu lus dang me thabs kyis 'od gsal/ gcig ni kha ṭāṃ gas ni bde stong gi rnam gzhag ston/ gcig ni me thabs bsdigs mdzub skyes bu gsal shing la bskyon pa gsum ste/ me thabs kyis shes rab che ba/ bsdigs 'dzum gyis pha brgyud ma rgyud kyi gnad mthar thug nga la yod ces mtshon shing*/ skyes bu gsal shing la bskyon pas ni sdig can btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya nus pa dang*/ gcig ni spyir rje btsun rgyal ba kun gyi yab yin pas rje btsun la bsten dgos shing*/ khyad par du rgyu 'bras gnyis dang ye shes sems dpa'i skabs su rje btsun gyi zhal dngos su yod pas rje btsun gyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel khyad par can dang ldan pa dang*/ gcig ni sngar bshad pa ltar bde gsang gnyis kyi sgo nas lam bgrod pa la yid na 'jigs byed bsten na bar chad thams cad zhi nas lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin par byed pa'i phyir ro/

/gzhan yang rwa gnyis kyis ni gzhi bden pa gnyis/ lam thabs shes gnyis/ 'bras bu gzugs sku gnyis 'grub tshul rnams nga la yod ces mtshon pa sogs mang ngo*/ /chos skyong yang skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i 'gros dang mthun pa zhig dgos te/ de yang las kyi gshin rje ni skyes bu chung ngu'i chos skyong du bsten pa dang*/ rnam thos sras ni skyes bu 'bring gi lam sgrub pa'i chos skyong dang*/ mgon po phyag drug pa ni skyes bu chen po'i lam sgrub pa'i chos skyong du bsten par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i lam ston pa'i bla ma yang yon tan phyogs re bas mi chog gi /sdom pa gsum dang ldan zhing nyes ltung dang bral ba/ sde gnod gsum la mkhas shing bslab pa gsum dang ldan pa/ rgyud sde bzhi la mkhas shing bskyed rdzogs ci rigs kyi rgyud smin pa sogs kyi yo tan dang ldan pa zhig bsam sbyor gnyis kyis bsten par bya la/ de bzhin du grogs kyang dad pa che ba/ ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod pa/ shes rab che ba bla ma dang des bstan pa'i chos pa gus shing 'jug pa sogs dang ldan pa zhig bsten par bya'o/ /tshogs zhing ni/ rang gi spyi bor seng khri'i steng du ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la rnam pa rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gsal ba la ye shes pa spyan drangs bstims nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang*/ gsol 'debs dbang bzhi len pa mthar rang gi snying ga'i thig le'i dbus su bzhugs pa'o/ /sgrib sbyong la lhung bshags/ yig brgya/ dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg stobs bzhi sogs bya dgos tshul bshad/ mdor na bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas bzung ste 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i bar gyi lam mthun mong bas rgyud sbyangs pa/ sku gsum gyi lam la 'khrid tshul/ dbang thob cing*/ de'i dam tshig gsung dgos pa/ rim gnyis rgyud la skye ba'i grangs nges go rims sogs la go ba chags par byed pa'o/

/'di dag la bshar sgom byed pa tsam yang nyams len gyi gnad tshang tshul 'di dag rje btsun la zhus la bskur zhig ces gsung ba bzhin/ bdag gis rje btsun la mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul te gsol 'debs shugs drag dang bcas zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis nyams len bya tshul 'di ltar gyis shig ces gsung ba bzhin yi ger btab nas phul ba lags/ rje nyid kyis rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la zhus nas red mda' ba la phul ba'i nyams len gyi gnad yongs su rdzogs par dril nas thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i tshul lo/ /zhes pa ni tshig don gyi snying po bsdus te bkod pa'o/ /'di dang snga ma gnyis ka yang nyams len la brtsams pa'i dri bar 'dug pas thos pa phyir bltas su ma song zhing nyams su len 'dod pa dag gis shes dgos pa yod do/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i lam gyi snying po kun/ /gcig bsdus lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum ste/ /ji bzhin ston mdzad rje btsun rje bla ma'i/ /man ngag mthar thug 'di las gzhan na gang*/ /'di yi dgongs don ma lus pa/ /blo dman bdag lta'i yul min yang*/ /dam pa gang gis thag ring nas/ /gsung gis bskul phyir bdag gis bris/ /mang thos 'dus sde'i rgya mtsho cher gnas pa'i/ /mkhas dbang gdengs can gtsug na legs bshad kyi/ /rin chen mchis bzhin phyogs kyi khron pa nas/ /'dod rgu'i yid bzhin len 'dod e ma mtshar/ /'on kyang dri zhim 'byung srid na/ /ri dwags lte bar gla rtsi bzhin/ /legs bshad byung na byis pa las/ /len la 'gal ba ga la mchis/ /de phyir dam pa'i gsung bzhin rje btsun rje'i/ /dgongs don 'grel ba'i tshul la 'bad pa'i dges/ /skyes kun yab sras gnyis kyis rjes bzung nas/ /bla med byang chub myur du thob gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni/ mkhan ang dkar zhabs drung nyi ma thang ba sher sbyin pa'i skye bar grags pa ar smon dbyangs can gzhon nu zhes bya ba/ 7 rgyal dbang bdun pa chen po'i dngos slob tu gyur ba de nyid kyis pho brang chen po po ta la nas 'di lta bu zhig gyis la bskur zhig ces pa'i gsung shog gis bskul ba ltar co ne'i slob dpon shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub ces bya bas bskul ba po'i gsung bzlog ma nus shing*/
